propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple orthogonal lifecycle concerns (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, ID re-keying, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, retirement) that should be extracted into a dedicated policy owner
Production code mutates binding state through shallow all_bindings() dictionary access, bypassing any future policy enforcement seam
A narrow facade operation for rich-text emission state must be added while preserving backward compatibility of all existing method signatures and all_bindings() shallow-copy semantics

Lifecycle operations must maintain at-most-one identity invariant via targeted reverse-key cleanup and preserve existing error-handling boundaries (confirmed 404 grace/reset, moved-key repair, corruption fail-open/fail-closed dispositions)
